title: The day, standing up
question: Vertical, top to bottom. Standing the rail up merges the two halves that had to be separate when it lay flat: an item now sits at its own place on the line WITH its name, so there is no rail-and-then-rows, only the day. Amber still means now and nothing else. Two ways.

options.label: B · a thread through the cards
options.thesis: One line runs down the whole day and every item hangs off it, evenly spaced, with 'עכשיו' marked in amber exactly where you are between them.
options.viewport: Four cards on a thread, now between the second and third.
options.risk: The spacing is even, so it shows the ORDER of the day and not its shape - a six-hour gap looks the same as a one-hour gap.

options.label: A · a true time axis
options.thesis: The line is the hours themselves, so an item sits at its own hour and the empty stretches of the day are as visible as the busy ones. The filled part is the day already spent.
options.viewport: Items at their real hours, with the gap between 11:00 and 17:00 left open.
options.risk: A day with two items close together overlaps them, and an empty afternoon is a large hole on the home screen. It is the honest one and the fragile one.
